description: Import the rows of a CSV or Excel file into a model: map columns to properties, convert numbers, dates and checkboxes, and update existing records instead of creating duplicates.
label: Import from CSV or Excel

options.name: file-url
options.label: URL to the import file
options.info: A public URL, or the url of a file property (e.g. from an Expression step). The step downloads the file from this URL.

options.name: file-type
options.label: Import file type
options.info: CSV or Excel. For Excel the first sheet is imported.

options.name: delimiter
options.label: Delimiter
options.info: The character between the values in a CSV file. Detect picks the one that occurs most in the header row. Not used for Excel.

options.name: model
options.label: Import model
options.info: The model the records are imported into.

options.name: import-mapping
options.label: Import mapping
options.info: KEY = column name in the file, VALUE = database name of the property, e.g. first_name. For a belongs-to relation: model.property, e.g. company.name. End a KEY with * to mark a required column.

options.name: format-mapping
options.label: Format mapping for import columns
options.info: KEY = column name, VALUE = checkbox, decimal, number, text, or Date, <format> (also Time, and Datetime,), e.g. Date, dd-MM-yyyy. Columns without a format are imported as text.

options.name: default-mapping
options.label: Default mapping
options.info: KEY = database name of a property or relation, VALUE = the value (or related record id) to set on every imported record.

options.name: deduplicate
options.label: Deduplicate records (update records if matched)
options.info: When on, a row whose unique column matches an existing record updates that record instead of creating a new one. Rows with an empty unique column are skipped.

options.name: unique-column
options.label: Unique record identifier (import column name)
options.info: The column that identifies a record, as written in the Import mapping. Used when Deduplicate records is on.

options.name: unique-type
options.label: Unique record type
options.info: The type of the property the unique column is mapped to. Used when Deduplicate records is on.

options.name: update-mapping
options.label: Update mapping for existing records
options.info: Same as the Import mapping, but used for records that are updated. Leave empty to update existing records with the Import mapping.

options.name: validate-required-columns
options.label: Validate required columns
options.info: When on, the step fails before importing anything if a column whose KEY ends with * is not in the file.

options.name: result
options.label: Result
options.info: How many records were created and updated, e.g. Records created: 10, records updated: 2.
